title: CuteAFD router logits across its 160/161-row route switch (one GPU, one kernel)
question: Are CuteAFD's GLM-5.3-Flash router logits bit-identical across the switch between its skinny GEMV route (up to 160 rows) and its TMA tensor-core route, a question its source audit left open?
engines: CuteAFD image (tag and digest not recorded in this run's files): sparkinfer b12x RoutedBf16Projection JIT-compiled from the image's source, torch 2.12.0a0+5aff3928d8.nv26.05
hardware: 1x NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Max-Q Workstation Edition

goals.question: Are CuteAFD's router logits bit-identical across its skinny-GEMV (up to 160 rows) / TMA tensor-core (above 160 rows) route switch, and if not, does expert selection or its weights change?
goals.added_source: README.md:5 (why it was run); 2026-10-26-cuteafd-setup-checks source audit E1

design.instrument: e1_router_route.py: RoutedBf16Projection(288, 4096, FP32 out) JIT-compiled from the CuteAFD image's sparkinfer b12x source (not the served AOT binary), real router weights and correction biases; top-8 of sigmoid score + bias, weights normalized x 2.5
arms: TMA route, same rows in a 161-row launch
design.items: layers 3, 12, 24, 36, 44 x two approximate input kinds (normalized embedding rows of seeded random token ids, and N(0,1) rows, times the post-attention norm weight); the real mHC-collapsed residual input was not reproduced
design.repeats: 40 batches per layer and input kind; torch generator seed 70901

goals.headline: Exploratory, one GPU, one kernel, approximate inputs: across the switch 0.35-0.37% of logits are bit-identical, max abs logit difference 1.7e-5 to 8.2e-5, top-8 set changed in 2 of 64,000 rows; where the set agreed, routing weights differed by at most 8.0e-7. The run reads launches above 160 rows as prefill chunks only; decode steps stay on the skinny route.

goals.question: Within each route, do CuteAFD's router logits depend on the launch's row count?

design.items: layers 3, 12, 24, 36, 44 x two approximate input kinds (normalized embedding rows of seeded random token ids, and N(0,1) rows, times the post-attention norm weight); the real mHC-collapsed residual input was not reproduced
design.repeats: 40 batches per layer and input kind; torch generator seed 70901

goals.headline: Exploratory: skinny 160 vs 100 rows and TMA 161 vs 512 rows are 100% bit-identical, max difference 0, top-8 set changed in 0 rows. README.md states 64,000 rows per comparison; the skinny 160-vs-100 comparison has 40,000 rows in e1-router-route.json.
goals.status_note: README.md:13 states 64,000 rows per comparison; in e1-router-route.json the skinny 160-vs-100 comparison has 40,000 rows (4,000 per cell) and the TMA 161-vs-512 comparison 64,000.

goals.headline: Exploratory: max error relative to the largest logit 1.0-1.6e-7 on the skinny route (top-8 set changed in 0 rows) and 5.3-6.8e-6 on the TMA route (2 rows); the run reads both changed rows as the TMA route moving a near-tie away from the FP64 choice, within an FP32 dot product's rounding.
